_comment: Maps this project's local model names to their exact OpenRouter model id (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models). scripts/fetch_pricing.py uses this to auto-refresh config/pricing.json. Add a line here whenever a brand-new local model name shows up (the app already notifies when that happens); until it's added, that model just stays unpriced.
_comment_grok: Confirmed against this project's own test fixtures (tests/test_adapters.py uses a real-shaped 'grok-4.5'), which matches OpenRouter's id exactly, same as OpenAI.
_comment_gemini: Not yet confirmed against real local Gemini CLI data on this machine - best guess based on the OpenAI/Grok pattern (local name matches OpenRouter's id exactly). Verify once real Gemini CLI logs are available, then drop this note.
